reply_text:
*Found one merge-blocking bug.*

*P1 — Multiple spaces aren’t removed* — `src/normalize.js:4`
`replace(' ', '')` removes only the first space. All three examples promised in `README.md:9` fail with `bad number`, leaving the outbox empty:
• `+44 20 7946 0958`
• `0044 20 7946 0958`
• `+1 (415) 555-0100`

*Recommended fix:* Remove spaces globally and add regression tests through `queueText` for those examples. The current normalization test (`test/normalize.test.js:5`) contains only one space, so it misses this.

All 5 existing tests pass. No code changes made; working tree is clean.
